_why: 2026-11-08: codex 0.167 skipped the untrusted h-mad gate, so a real codex worker wrote a listed file with no RED. Dispatch passes --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust only for a gate-only hooks.json under a sandbox that keeps .codex/ unwritable. Each row reverts one of those conditions.

mutations.name: HT-ARG
mutations._mechanism: Without the flag codex skips the untrusted h-mad gate.

mutations.name: HT-ONLY-GATE
mutations._mechanism: A hooks.json holding any foreign hook must not be run unreviewed.
mutations.find: sys.exit(0 if commands and all(c == GATE for c in commands) else 1)  # M:HT-ONLY-GATE
mutations.replace: sys.exit(0 if commands and any(c == GATE for c in commands) else 1)  # M:HT-ONLY-GATE

mutations.name: HT-SANDBOX
mutations._mechanism: Under a sandbox that can write .codex/ the worker could plant a hook, so no bypass.

mutations.name: HT-NO-HOOKS
mutations._mechanism: No project hooks: nothing to bypass and nothing to warn about.
mutations.find: [ -f "$hooks" ] || return 0  # M:HT-NO-HOOKS nothing to run, nothing to bypass
mutations.replace: true  # M:HT-NO-HOOKS nothing to run, nothing to bypass

mutations.name: HT-TOP
mutations._mechanism: Hooks live at the git top; --cd may be a subdirectory.

mutations.name: HT-SANDBOX-RETURN
mutations._mechanism: The unsafe-sandbox arm must stop, not fall through to vetting and grant the flag.
